**Illegality cannot be determined from the satellite evidence alone.**

The data indicate 13.5 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2025, of which 13.1 hectares overlap forest mapped as native by Uruguay’s agriculture ministry. However, no later year was available to corroborate the event under the tool’s stated rule.

The evidence does not establish whether the clearing was authorized or whether an applicable legal exception applied. Confirming legality would require checking the relevant MGAP authorization and the circumstances of the clearing.
